content.text:
**Yes, it can be approved, but only with Director of Finance approval (Elena Novak) and VP Sales concurrence (Michael Torres).** Sarah Chen has no authority to approve it herself.

**The request.** CR-9203 matches the Northstar ERP record exactly. It asks to raise Acme's limit from $250,000 to $1,000,000. Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive) submitted it on 2026-09-23. It relies on the Acme Group parent guarantee.

**The customer.** ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" and CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" are the same company. They share the same DUNS number (04-812-7730) and address. The CRM tier is **Strategic**.

**The policy.** CREDIT-POLICY-2026 is in force on 2026-09-23.

**Payment history.** The rule is that no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid, or be unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date. Acme meets it:
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24, on time.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22, on time.
- INV-62305 ($720,000) is due 2026-10-02, after the request date, so the rule does not apply to it.

**The maximum limit is $1,150,000.**
- The Strategic tier maximum is $750,000.
- Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 adds $400,000. It is registered, names Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001, same DUNS) only, and is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31.
- The requested $1,000,000 is within this maximum, so Acme is **eligible**.

**Authority.**
- The new total of $1,000,000 is above $500,000, so it needs **Director of Finance** approval: Elena Novak.
- Acme is Strategic and the limit is above $500,000, so it also needs **VP Sales** concurrence: Michael Torres.
- Sarah Chen is neither of these. Separation of duties is still met, because neither required person submitted the request.

**Worth noting.** INV-62305 ($720,000) was still unpaid as of today, 2026-10-08, which is 6 days past due. That is within the 30-day tolerance, and the decision is judged as of the request date, so it does not block the decision.

              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (EMP-101, Enterprise Account Executive)", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1150000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Strategic maximum $750,000 + GRT-ACME-2026 parent guarantee $400,000 (names Acme Mfg. Holdings, C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730; in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31); no invoice due in prior 12 months paid or unpaid >30 days past due",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance (approval); VP Sales (concurrence, Strategic account > $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["structured/credit_requests.csv CR-9203", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 (Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "structured/erp_credit.csv C-1001 (limit 250000)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305", "structured/employees.csv", "OWM register: CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "OWM register: GRT-ACME-2026"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [{"what": "INV-62305 ($720,000, due 2026-10-02) remained unpaid as of 2026-10-08; within the 30-day tolerance and not due as of the request date, but approvers should note the open exposure", "who": "Elena Novak (Director of Finance)", "blocking": false}]
}
